CharacterCardEntity.description:
One character in a list.

Deliberately not ``CharacterEntity``: ``id`` and the wiki page keys
are not public (D5). Appearances and piloted suits are on the
detail only (``models.character.detail``).
CharacterCardEntity.title: CharacterCardEntity

CharacterDetailEntity.description:
A character, with their works and the suits they pilot.

Both lists are bounded (a character pilots tens of suits, not
hundreds), so they nest instead of paging.
CharacterDetailEntity.title: CharacterDetailEntity

CharacterRefEntity.description: Just enough of a character to name and link them elsewhere.
CharacterRefEntity.title: CharacterRefEntity

CharacterResponse.description: One character, with their works and the suits they pilot.
CharacterResponse.title: CharacterResponse

CitedWorkEntity.description:
A work someone or something appears in, with the page saying so.

Shared by character and organization details, whose appearance
rows carry no episode range (unlike a suit's).
CitedWorkEntity.title: CitedWorkEntity

ContentLicense.description: The terms a source's content is published under (ADR 0002).
ContentLicense.title: ContentLicense

ContinuitiesListResponse.description: Every continuity. Unpaginated, so it has no ``meta``.
ContinuitiesListResponse.title: ContinuitiesListResponse

ContinuityCardEntity.description:
One continuity in the list of every continuity.

Leaves out ``id``: slugs are the public key (D2, D5).
ContinuityCardEntity.title: ContinuityCardEntity

ContinuityRefEntity.description:
Just enough of a continuity to name and link it from a card.

Deliberately not a card: nesting full cards inside other cards
would make every list load a chain of rows.
ContinuityRefEntity.title: ContinuityRefEntity

DesignedMobileSuitEntity.description: A suit in a designer's list, with the page crediting them.
DesignedMobileSuitEntity.title: DesignedMobileSuitEntity

DesignerCreditEntity.description: A mechanical designer credited with the suit.
DesignerCreditEntity.title: DesignerCreditEntity

HealthCheckStatus.description: The state the health check reports.
HealthCheckStatus.title: HealthCheckStatus

HomeInfo.description: What the homepage says about the API.
HomeInfo.title: HomeInfo

MechanicalDesignerCardEntity.description:
One mechanical designer, in a list or on their own page.

Deliberately not ``MechanicalDesignerEntity``: ``id`` and the wiki
page keys are not public (D5). Their suits are a paginated route of
their own, since one designer can have hundreds (RDB-23).
MechanicalDesignerCardEntity.title: MechanicalDesignerCardEntity

MechanicalDesignerMobileSuitsListRespons.description: One page of the suits a designer is credited with.
MechanicalDesignerMobileSuitsListRespons.title: MechanicalDesignerMobileSuitsListResponse

MechanicalDesignerRefEntity.description: Just enough of a designer to name and link them elsewhere.
MechanicalDesignerRefEntity.title: MechanicalDesignerRefEntity

MobileSuitAppearanceCardEntity.description: A suit in one work's list, with how it appears there.
MobileSuitAppearanceCardEntity.title: MobileSuitAppearanceCardEntity

MobileSuitCardEntity.description:
One suit in a list.

Deliberately not the detail: loading spec sheets for fifty cards
would cost an N+1 or a large join that nothing renders (D5). Leaves
out ``id`` and ``fandom_page_id``: slugs are the public key.
MobileSuitCardEntity.title: MobileSuitCardEntity

MobileSuitDetailEntity.description:
A suit, with its sheets, relations, appearances and credits.

Each nested list is read in one query, so a detail read costs the
same few statements however many rows it holds (PYTEST-24). The
people and organizations are refs: their own pages hold the rest
(Q5). Parts join the spec sheets in a later PR.
MobileSuitDetailEntity.title: MobileSuitDetailEntity

MobileSuitOrganizationRole.description: What an organization does for a mobile suit.
MobileSuitOrganizationRole.title: MobileSuitOrganizationRole

MobileSuitRelationType.description:
How one mobile suit descends from another, read from → to.

``(Worker Zaku, Zaku II, variant_of)`` reads "the Worker Zaku is a
variant of the Zaku II".
MobileSuitRelationType.title: MobileSuitRelationType

MobileSuitResponse.description: One suit, with its spec sheets, relations and appearances.
MobileSuitResponse.title: MobileSuitResponse

MobileSuitSpecSheetEntity.description:
One configuration's specs, as one source gives them.

Deliberately not ``SpecSheetEntity``: ``raw_infobox`` is bulky
copied wiki text, kept out of anything served (D5), and ``id`` is
not a public key.

A named configuration's gaps are filled from the base sheet of the
same source; ``inherited_fields`` names the columns that were, so a
page can tell "same as base" from a value the source states.
MobileSuitSpecSheetEntity.title: MobileSuitSpecSheetEntity

OrganizationCardEntity.description:
One organization in a list.

Deliberately not ``OrganizationEntity``: ``id`` and the wiki page
keys are not public (D5). The parent is a ref, so a list costs no
query per card.
OrganizationCardEntity.title: OrganizationCardEntity

OrganizationCreditEntity.description: An organization's role for the suit, in one work or in none.
OrganizationCreditEntity.title: OrganizationCreditEntity

OrganizationDetailEntity.description:
An organization, with its units and the works it appears in.

Leaves out its suits, which have their own paginated route: the
Earth Federation alone operates hundreds (RDB-23).
OrganizationDetailEntity.title: OrganizationDetailEntity

OrganizationLinkEntity.description: One role an organization has for a suit, in one work or none.
OrganizationLinkEntity.title: OrganizationLinkEntity

OrganizationMobileSuitEntity.description:
A suit in an organization's list, with every role it has there.

One item per suit, not per link, so a page of cards holds distinct
suits; its links (one per role and work) are grouped in ``links``.
OrganizationMobileSuitEntity.title: OrganizationMobileSuitEntity

OrganizationMobileSuitsListResponse.description: One page of an organization's suits, each with its links.
OrganizationMobileSuitsListResponse.title: OrganizationMobileSuitsListResponse

OrganizationRefEntity.description: Just enough of an organization to name and link it elsewhere.
OrganizationRefEntity.title: OrganizationRefEntity

OrganizationResponse.description: One organization, with its parent, units and works.
OrganizationResponse.title: OrganizationResponse

PageMeta.description:
Where a page sits in its list (fastapi.md FAPI-12).

A plain model, not an envelope, so its fields stay ``snake_case``.
``total`` counts every row the filters match, across every page.
PageMeta.title: PageMeta

PilotCreditEntity.description: A character who pilots the suit, in one work or in none.
PilotCreditEntity.title: PilotCreditEntity

PilotedMobileSuitEntity.description:
A suit a character pilots, in one work or in a work not recorded.

``work`` is null when the page names no work for the pairing; such
rows sort after the ones with a work.
PilotedMobileSuitEntity.title: PilotedMobileSuitEntity

RelatedMobileSuitEntity.description:
A suit linked to the viewed one, read from the viewed one's side.

Direct edges only: the whole family tree is a route of its own when
a screen needs it (D5). ``created_at`` is when this database stored
the edge, not when the wiki recorded it.
RelatedMobileSuitEntity.title: RelatedMobileSuitEntity

RelatedWorkEntity.description:
A work linked to the viewed one, read from the viewed one's side.

``created_at`` is when this database stored the edge; the source's
``revision_id`` says which copy of the page it came from (D5, D6).
RelatedWorkEntity.title: RelatedWorkEntity

SourceCitationEntity.description:
The source a served fact cites, for its attribution (D6).

Deliberately not ``SourceEntity``: ``external_id`` means nothing to
a reader, since ``url`` already names the page, and ``id`` is not a
public key (D5).

``retrieved_at`` and ``revision_id`` say which copy of the page the
catalog holds; they say nothing about this database's row times.

license_name.description: The license's name, such as ``CC BY-SA 3.0`` (D6).
license_name.title: License Name

revision_url.description:
A permalink to the revision the catalog holds, or ``None``.

Share-alike attribution points at the version used, not the
live page (D6). ``None`` when no revision was recorded.
revision_url.title: Revision Url

SourceCitationEntity.title: SourceCitationEntity

SourceKind.description:
The kind of upstream page a catalog fact came from.

One kind per wiki: page IDs are unique only within a wiki, and each
wiki needs its own sync watermark in ``ingest_runs``.
SourceKind.title: SourceKind

UnitType.description:
The kind of mobile weapon, from the Gundam Wiki infobox ``type``.

Only the kinds the catalog holds: the wiki's Ship, Vehicle, Weapon
and Bit pages are out of scope.
UnitType.title: UnitType

WorkAppearanceEntity.description: A work the viewed suit appears in, with its episode range.
WorkAppearanceEntity.title: WorkAppearanceEntity

WorkCardEntity.description:
One work in a list.

Deliberately not ``WorkEntity``: a list renders no external IDs, and
``id`` is not a public key (D5). Relations are on the detail only.
WorkCardEntity.title: WorkCardEntity

WorkDetailEntity.description:
A work, with its parent and every work it is directly linked to.

Leaves out external IDs and ``id`` (D5), and the work's suits, which
have their own paginated route.
WorkDetailEntity.title: WorkDetailEntity

WorkMobileSuitsListResponse.description: One page of the suits that appear in a work.
WorkMobileSuitsListResponse.title: WorkMobileSuitsListResponse

WorkRefEntity.description: Just enough of a work to name and link it from another work.
WorkRefEntity.title: WorkRefEntity

WorkRelationType.description:
How one work relates to another, read ``from`` → ``to``.

``(Zeta, MSG, sequel_of)`` reads "Zeta is a sequel of MSG".
WorkRelationType.title: WorkRelationType

WorkResponse.description: One work, with its parent and relations.
WorkResponse.title: WorkResponse

WorkType.description: The medium of a Gundam work.
WorkType.title: WorkType
